notablePrerequisites: Heronblade Elite does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding an amount of {R} equal to its power.
Cast Fanning the Flames with buyback by paying a total of at least {5}{R}{R}.
Raggadragga's third ability triggers, untapping Heronblade Elite and giving it +7/+7 until end of turn.
Resolve Fanning the Flames, dealing at least two damage to any target and returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
